source: Department of Telecommunications, reply to Lok Sabha Starred Question 470 (25 March 2026). Villages without mobile coverage, as on 28 February 2026.
title: *8,748* villages
in India have no
mobile signal.
title_sub: Where are they? Every state, mapped.
headline: Villages with
*no mobile signal*

draw.text: Each one coloured by how many of its villages have no mobile coverage at all.

all.line1: Five states hold *more than half* of them.

insight.text: In *Arunachal Pradesh*, 1,176 of 5,993 villages have no mobile signal. Across India it is about 1 in 74.

yt_title: 8,748 Indian villages have no mobile signal. Where? 🗺️

vo.title: 8,748 Indian villages have no mobile signal. Where?
vo.b0: Zero: Kerala, Delhi and three union territories.
vo.b1: Under 50: ten more, like Tamil Nadu and Punjab.
vo.b2: Up to 250: most of the north-east.
vo.all: Those five hold over half of them.
vo.top: Odisha and Arunachal lead, almost tied.
vo.insight: But in Arunachal, that's 1 in 5 villages.
vo.end: Is your village covered? Comment below.
